description: We are Space Nova, a creative and passionate team of builders, problem-solvers, and space enthusiasts participating in the Space Apps Hackathon. Combining skills in game development, design, and space research, we love turning complex scientific concepts into engaging, hands-on experiences.
summary:
Mars Mission Lab is a free, browser-based space mission design game created by Team Space Nova 26 for the NASA Space Apps Challenge (November 14–15, 2026). Built for learners of all ages without requiring any lab equipment, the game challenges students to design, launch, and manage a Mars mission using real NASA data and engineering principles.

Players progress through six interactive stages: planning mission concepts within mass, power, and cost budgets; executing launches using Hohmann transfers; surviving the "seven minutes of terror" during arrival; managing surface operations through dust storms and freezing nights; timing Deep Space Network communications; and comparing final science reports against real NASA missions like Perseverance and Opportunity.

Powered by a physics engine incorporating Newton’s and Kepler’s laws, solar power, and signal delay, the platform turns both mission successes and historical failures—such as the Mars Climate Orbiter—into hands-on learning. Upon completing all three training levels, participants earn a Mars Mission Designer certificate.
details: Mars Mission Lab is a free, browser-based educational game by Team Space Nova 26 that lets learners of all ages design, launch, and manage a Mars mission without lab equipment. Players navigate six stages (Concept, Launch, Arrival, Operations, Ground, and Science), applying real NASA data, Newton’s and Kepler’s laws, Hohmann transfers, solar power, and signal delay. Built using a physics engine, Claude AI, and Canva, the project creatively turns mission constraints and historical failures like the Mars Climate Orbiter into interactive lessons. Aiming to reach over 1,000,000 learners worldwide, it awards a Mars Mission Designer certificate upon completing all levels.
